summary: Enforce release support policy and source-linked changelog fragments
details: Validate event-based security support windows and preserve withdrawal records with explicit install exclusions.
Require material source deliveries to update a versioned change fragment; generate the Unreleased section without rewriting earlier manual or published notes.
Allow an explicit no-changelog PR label only after authenticated repository, state and exact-source verification; normal pull requests may carry one fragment across their delivery.

compatibility.notes: This change affects release tooling and documentation; it does not change HTTP, SDK or database contracts.

security: Withdrawal selection runs before release downloads or packaging. Fragment and Git inputs are bounded and reject symlinks. Label waivers use authenticated read-only GitHub APIs with exact repository and source binding; provider payloads and publisher secrets are not logged or passed to unrelated tools.
limitations: Local checks do not prove independent review, token scope, artifact publication or hosted integration.
The earlier source snapshot remains historical development evidence and is not a newly published release.
